name: fl-farlume
title: Household Cashflow Tracker
description: Track spending, detect recurring patterns, forecast cashflow with statistical models.
audience: Individuals and households who want honest visibility into where their money goes and how long it will last — without uploading bank data to a third-party service.
useCases: A household imports three months of bank statements to find out exactly where R8,000 a month is disappearing to — discovers forgotten subscriptions and a grocery creep
Someone between jobs needs to know how long their savings will last — the cash runway forecast shows they have 4.2 months at current spend, so they cut non-essentials
A couple compares this month’s spending to last month’s — side-by-side workspaces show groceries up 15% and transport down 30% after switching to a carpool
A freelancer with irregular income imports invoices and expenses — recurring pattern detection separates predictable costs from variable ones to plan around lean months

dataPrivacy.storage: All data stored locally on-device using IndexedDB. No server, no cloud.
dataPrivacy.export: Full data exportable as JSON for backup or re-import.
dataPrivacy.thirdParty: No data sent to any external service.
